summary: Essex County, VA tower the Forest Lookout Association lists as Caret (Upper Essex), standing; no build date, builder, staffing or access details found.

evidence.supports: FFLA lists Caret (Upper Essex) as a standing tower in Essex County at 37.98414, -77.04153, with no register number
Forest Lookouts lists Upper Essex in Essex County, with no history text
FFLA lists Center Cross (Lower Essex) in Essex County as a separate standing tower at different coordinates
evidence.quote: Essex Center Cross (Lower Essex) 37.78837 -76.78082 Tower Standing

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The FFLA list is the only tower-specific source and gives name, county, coordinates and status. The Forest Lookouts Upper Essex entry has a heading, the county and a region label (VALLEY RIDGE) only; it carries a photo whose caption, credit and licence are unknown, so no photo is recorded. The story now says the entry gives the name and county with no history, without saying 'only'. The Virginia Department of Forestry and NHLR Virginia listings were not checked for this site. Name variants: Caret (FFLA) and Upper Essex (Forest Lookouts) are treated as one site, which is an inference from the matching county and name. Suggested next steps: Virginia Department of Forestry history and Essex County newspaper archives.
